mechanism: Use three colored open U frames on the existing bases and end sides of the three rows. Predict 18 by adding the row-rectangle perimeters 8+6+4 while overlooking cancellation of the two shared horizontal interfaces.
design_difference: Old preset18 singled out only three full vertical internal seams and used 24-2*3; old preset14 equated fractional shoulders with one full side. This instead groups each actual horizontal row as a composed rectangle using its open three-sided frame, with internal vertical seams black, and predicts the sum of the three strip perimeters. No closed new partition is drawn.
primary_math_proof: The three actual row rectangles have widths3,2,1 and height1, so separate row perimeters sum8+6+4=18. Their two horizontal contact lengths are2 and1, each counted twice in that sum. The union perimeter is18-2*(2+1)=12. Equivalently horizontal exterior lengths telescope to6 and vertical exterior lengths sum6. Frozen offsets .75 and1 do not alter this. All six individual square boundaries stay present, no region or edge is added.
